tools.name: ztds_sanitize
tools.description: Zero-Trust Data Sanitization. Replaces PII, PHI, and confidential secrets in client memory before passing prompts to LLMs.

text.description: The raw sensitive text to sanitize

tools.name: ztds_restore
tools.description: Restores original unmasked data from surrogate tokens locally in volatile RAM.

text.description: The sanitized text with surrogate tokens to restore

tools.name: ztds_audit
tools.description: Audits a codebase or document for confidential PII and calculates cryptographic SHA-256 compliance receipts.

text.description: The text or file contents to audit

tools.name: ztds_info
tools.description: Returns current ZTDS RFC v1.0 standard status, active RAM session stats, and engine version.

tools.name: ztds_reset_session
tools.description: Explicitly zeroes and destroys the in-memory surrogate mapping table.
